reports.title: Donchian-20 breakout: baseline plan R by direction and year
reports.headline: 592,687 matured breakouts: mean -0.018 R (95% CI -0.063 to +0.030); bullish +0.042 R, bearish -0.095 R.

reports.title: Parameter-free rankers: year-by-year stability
reports.headline: 'Less extended in its own direction' (vs the 52-week high) has a positive top-minus-bottom quintile R spread in 8 of 9 years (mean +0.168 R). 7 related candidates were tried.

reports.title: ML evaluation runs (evaluate-only) and the promotion gate
reports.headline: No model passes the a-priori gate. The legacy momentum target is predictable (holdout AUC 0.627) but does not rank the trade's profit (AUC 0.506 bullish / 0.492 bearish within direction).

reports.title: Donchian exit-policy comparison (same entries, same costs)
reports.headline: 72,262 breakouts x 5 policies: best net expectancy -0.048 R (A_atr_stop_fixed_2R); no policy differs from the fixed-3R exit beyond noise (every paired interval includes zero). Bearish trades lose under every policy.

reports.title: Earnings catalysts: reaction, drift and the breakout interaction
reports.headline: 39,706 liquid earnings events: surprise >= +10% -> +2.45% market-adjusted reaction, surprise <= -10% -> -3.72%; post-reaction 20-day drift -0.16% / -0.42% (intervals include zero): the market prices the surprise immediately.

reports.title: Recent large earnings surprises (research feed, not alerts)
reports.headline: 40 liquid events with surprise >= +25% in the last 40 days of data, each with its market-adjusted reaction so far.
